[[Image:Piotr Pustelnik.jpg|thumb|right|Piotr Pustelnik (2006)]]

'''Piotr Pustelnik''' (born 12 July 1951 in [[Łódź]], [[Poland]]) is a Polish alpine and high-altitude climber.<ref name=":0">{{cite web|url=http://explorersweb.com/everest_k2/news.php?id=19295|title=Piotr Pustelnik summits Annapurna – bags the 14x8000ers!|publisher=Explorersweb.com|access-date=2014-02-21|archive-date=10 March 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160310233641/http://explorersweb.com/everest_k2/news.php?id=19295|url-status=dead}}</ref> He is the 20th man to climb all fourteen [[eight-thousander]]s.  He is also a doctor of chemistry and researcher at the [[Łódź University of Technology]].<ref>{{Cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=fIFOAQAAIAAJ |title=Przekrój |date=2010 |publisher=Krakowskie Wydawnictwo Prasowe |language=pl}}</ref>
